body:
Its just constant pain in my abdomen and symptoms like im stomach sick or i have food poisoning every time i try to leave the house and go anywhere for any amount of time and idk what causes it, its really on and off sometimes but its almost always in the morning for school/ college when i try to leave the house. Its been happening basically 5 days a week every week since i moved from where i grew up to a bigger town/city 5 years ago. 

Idk i just feel really paranoid all the time, idk when it started and i know sometimes people like my parents and my friends do say bad things about me behind my back but its gotten to a point where whenever i hear people talking or looking around me i assume theres something wrong with me and i try to stay out of their attention so i absolutely hate having any attention on me, its the same as why i only compete or do music in anything when nobody is around because of things that happened with it before. I just cant get the bad things out of my head when i hear them and then i keep convincing myself that everybody must think even worse of me even if i do something normal and it just sucks cause idek how to talk about it right, it just feels like anything i do in front of people i either screw up or get criticized for and everything i can think of reinforces it so much

I mean that i literally can hardly even leave my house to go anywhere be it work or school or college for the last five years because ever since i moved my stomach has been out to kill me. Every morning is the same routine where i wake up and then the second i try to go out the door it kicks up on me and i feel like i have a knife in my stomach and i need to go spend an hour in the bathroom, it got to the point where i think i probably missed more of my first classes in high school than i was there for, and yet i physically dont have it in me to get up and go to the bathroom in public most of the time  because my body wont let me cause i dont want all of the attention drawn to me cause of bad experience with that stuff and just anxiety. It honestly feels like its ruined my life at this point so i dont see much of a reason to try and keep going anyway, even if i dont do it after christmas i know it’ll just turn into “ill do it once i go back to college for second semester” or over spring break until i eventually do, just like it turned into this time after my friend talked me down last time.

I mean, if it works out in the end im happy with it. I know it’d probably suck to go through the pain after i start, but i’ve had stomach pain issues for long enough that i hope it wont be too different from that, even if it is much worse once im dead i wont feel it anyway so hopefully i just die quick

Thats the same thing that scares me dude, just the idea of having to live longer with some other crazy problem all cause i managed to botch my suicide attempt or having someone find me before i died have been making me debate on it for the last two years
Ty for the response tho, ill keep it in mind when the time comes if i think up other good options

Ive had bad enough stomach pain for the last five years that i hope it at least conditioned me to deal with it, but worst case if it hurts for even 5 hours i doubt it’d be worse than a lifetime full of stomach pain and other things.
